book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Maluko

content: Yesu bumpeleka kwaka Pilato
Ekwakusa, agolu akolongu baketangana pamu na aseja, na abola ba malagalaki na bandu boa ba pasengu bajetangannya kunkonga Yesu pengu nu kumpeleka kwaka Pilatu.
Pilatu andalukiya Yesu, “Boo wehapa lee gu Nkolongu wa Ayaude?” Yesu jaapwagila. “Ena, ngati egupwagike weapa.”
Agolu akolongu buntakila Yesu kwa malobi gangi ginge.
Pilatu andalukiya kabee Yesu, “Boo, mbona ngasegupwaga lilobe? Joannya ebugutaki kwa malobi gingi.”
Lakini Yesu ngasejapwagiki lilobe, mbaki Pilatu jasangii.
Yesu buntemu kuwa
Kila Lisoba likolongu la Pasaka, Pilatu jayobali kunhogule mpugwa jumu jobumpala.
Ndienu jabii mundu jumu joankema Balaba, jojuwe jabii ankongiki pamu na bangi babatei puju nukukoma bandu.
Bandu bangi bunzendila Pilato, bundoba jwaatendila ngati kawaida jaki.
Pilatu jalalukya, “Boo, mpala nunhogulya Bambu Nkolongu juku Uyahude?”
Jwapwaaga hela ndaba jwamanyiki agolu akolongu bumpelika Yesu kwaki ndaba babia bumbone wipu.
Lakini agolu akolongu bakolua bandu bundoba pilatu jaabopulya Balaba badala jaka Yesu.
Pilatu jalalukya kabee, “Ndienu, mpala nunhengila ki mundu jomunkema Nkolongu jwa Ayaude hojo?”
Bandu boa bajamalya kabee, “Unkomangalya punsalaba!”
Lakini pilatu jalalukya, “Ndaba jakii! Jutei kihakau bole?” Lakini bombi bajonzukya kujamalii. “Nkomangaliya punsalaba!”
Pilatu japala, jwapala nsambi wa bandu gola gwiyoma, ndienu andekakya Balaba kuhuma muligelesa. Jwaapwgila bandu bunndapula Yesu iboku nukukomangale punsalaba.
Aka linzolinzoli bundongama Yesu
Ndipala manzolinzoli bumpelika Yesu pasengu ja nyumba jaka Pilatu, jojabii nkolongu ju ndema Ndienu baakusanya manzolinzoli boka.
Bunhwatika Yesu ingobu ja zambalau ngati Bambu Nkolongu, balenganakiya hingu ja miha, bunhwatika pamutu.
Batumbuka kundamuu, “Jambuoti, u Nkolongu wa Ayaude!”
Bundapula pamutu na nndai, nu kunhuni imata, bapega magoti nu kunzinamii.
Ebaboka batenda kundongama, buhulaa ingobu ya zambalau ye yela, nukunhwatika ingobu yake, ndi bumpelika nukunkomangale punsalaba.
Yesu akomangale punsalaba

Pababii mwiindela, baketangini na mundu jumwa ankema Simoni, mwenei juku Kilene. Bombi babia ahengo baka Alekizanda na Lupu. Na muda we hogu jabia juhuma kukijijini. Manzolinzoli bundasimisa Simoni kutogo nsalaba gojabii naku Yesu.
Ndipala, bumpelika Yesu mbaka pandu pabakema Goligota, maana jaki, pandu papabonikana ngati “Pandu piliupa lu umutu.”
Ndienu, bumpekya Yesu divai jeahangagini mitela jebijikema manemane. Lakini Yesu jatenda kukana
Ndienu bunkomangalya punsalaba, nukubagana ingobu yaki kwa gudugudu ili amanya nyaa jupata ingobu boo.
Ekwabia lisaa la tatu pulukela pabunkomangalya punsalaba.
Na panani ju nsalaba baandiki malobi gu kuntaki ganga, “NKOLONGU JWA AYAUDI.”
Papuje baakomangalya bii habeli mumisalaba pambipi na Yesu, jumu upandi wa malele na jongi upandi wa mangega waka Yesu.
Ndienu gatimi Mahandiku gagapwaga, “Ambei likundi limu na bandu abaya.”
Bandu bababiapeta pandu pala, bannyua imutu yabu nu kuntondo nu kupwaga, “Ooo! Wehapa ndi wewapwaga witunula Nyumba jaka Sapanga nukusenga kwa masoba matato!
Enu, guhuluka munsalaba ulikombula wamwete!”
Nabombi agolu akolongu pamu na abola bamalagalaki bundongama nu kumpwagani beni na beni, “Jahokua bangi, lakini kulihoko mweni ngakuwesa!
Eti jombi Kilisitu, bambu nkolongu juku Izilaeli! Ndienu juhuluka kuhuma punsalaba ili tumbona nukunhobale.” Hata bandu bangi bala babaakomangali mumisalaba pambipi jaki nabombi batenda kuntondoo.
Yesu jukuwa punsalaba
Kutumbuka lisaa la sita lyobamutu mbaka lisaa la tisa pakamii lwii lwayekalya nndema woka.
Lisaa la tisa pakamii Yesu jalela kwa sauti ngolongu, koni jakapwaga, “Eloi, Eloi lema Sabakitani?” Maana jaki, “Sapanga wango, Sapanga wango, ndaba jaki guneka kajika jango?”
Bandu bangi babajemiki pala pabajoa hela bapwaga, “Joanya! Ankema Elia.”
Mundu jumu jabutuka, jajubika kipongu divai jejibaba, nukujibeka panani ja nndai, ambekila pundomu nukupwaga, “Lendalya tugubona ana Elia juhika kuguhuluu punsalaba jehapa!”
Ndipala Yesu jajamalya kwa makili, ndienu jatenda kuwa.
Kipindi sela, lipazia la Nyumba jaka Sapanga lakajuka pikilanda ipandi ibeli tumbuka kunani mbaka pai.
Nkolongu wa manzolinzoli jumwa jojabia jujemiki palongi jaki pajabona namuna jejakua Yesu japwaga, “Sakaka mundu hajo jwabii Mwana waka Sapanga!”
Babii kabee aka mbomba babalingalya sukutali, kati jabu jakabii Malia juku Magidala na Salomi na Malia amabu baka nkombu Yakobu na Yose.
Aka mbomba haba ndi babunzengalya Yesu pajabii ku Galilaya nukunzangatii. Kwabii na aka mbomba bangi bingi babahika ku Yelusalemu pamu najombi.
Nhega jaka Yesu abeka mlitenge
Ekwahika pakamii. Helilabia lisoba lukubeka sapi, yani lisoba lelilongulii Lisoba lu Kupomulela.

Papuje, jahika Josepu mwenei juku Alimatayo, ntenga wa Sengu ngolongu, jwabii mundu jwiniisima. Kabee jwabia mundu jojulendale kuhika ku Ukolongu waka Sapanga. Ndienu anzendila Pilatu bila kujogopa, jaaloba bumpekya nhyega jaka Yesu.
Pilatu jasangia kujoana Yesu jabia juwii. Ndienu, ankema nkolongu jwa manzolinzoli, andalukiya ana gupetiki muda gwingi toka Yesu pajuwii.
Nkolongu wa alonda hejwabii ampwagi Pilatu Yesu juwii, ampwagila Josepu juku Alimatayo jajukua nhyega jaka Yesu.
Papuje Josepu jalomba sanda jikitani, jijihelia nhyega je jela nukujiyongulakee sanda. Jabeka mlikabuli lelabii pililibu la soma, ndipala jwilihingalya lilibu likolongu kulibeka pundyangu.
Nabombi Malia juku Magidala na Malia amabu baka Yose balingaliya papu pabumbei.
